author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Before's root circle had shrunk to an r3 dot with a pinhole (the orthogonal bus used up the height), so the chart read as a plug or menorah and the circle root was lost. Now an r7 root circle is clearly the parent, with three connectors fanning from its bottom node to three 8x8 child boxes spaced 8 apart.
omissions: The orthogonal bus with rounded corners was replaced by fan connectors; 8-unit spacing on a 32-tall keyshape can't hold a readable root circle, a bus and three boxes at once.
